alternative_explanations: A fixed correlation threshold may simply recover a deliberately separated error-correcting code, so robustness could come from identifiable clustering rather than learned energy reasoning.
Incremental sequential repair may remove the apparent operation advantage and show that one-round relaxation is only a scheduling presentation of independent bit corrections.
Nearest-pattern or Hopfield controls may fail because training examples are noisy even though a denoised modern Hopfield implementation could remain competitive.
confounds: K counts redundant compositions of eight latent relations rather than independent open-world facts; fit, state and query work must be reported separately.

The generator guarantees a preregistered correlation gap and one test error per affected component, so positive evidence cannot be generalized to overlapping, ambiguous or learned real-valued representations.
falsification_criteria: Reduce HYP-0007 and stop tuning this family if robust_parallel_energy falls below 0.95 exact held-out accuracy in any seed or cell, has nonzero spurious-attractor rate, loses monotonicity, needs more than one round, or any preregistered generator invariant fails.

Treat the claimed architectural advantage as null if incremental_sequential_energy matches robust parallel in accuracy and total work so that the only remaining difference is a hand-scheduled round count, or if robust parallel has absolute per-seed query K slope above 0.05 or exceeds 0.12 of classical Hopfield query operations.

outcome_policy.negative: If noisy unequal relations break recovery or create spurious attractors in any seed, reduce HYP-0007 toward uncertain or dormant, preserve the failure, and test a different architecture family.
outcome_policy.null: If robust recovery works but a credible incremental or Hopfield control matches the full cost signature, classify the result as a known factored error-correcting mechanism, lower novelty confidence and pivot rather than optimize it.
outcome_policy.positive: Keep HYP-0007 testing and consider a different-task transfer only if the robust learned model replicates across all seeds with the registered dynamics and scaling signature; do not claim an LLM successor or novelty over prior art.

predicted_outcome: Each seed uses eight opaque unequal components totaling 36 bits, exactly two noisy training bits per pattern, incomplete latent balance, visible within-component parity agreement at least 0.75 and cross-component association at most 0.625. Every clean target is a held-out composition and each query corrupts one bit in each of D distinct components. Random, majority and nearest controls have exact accuracy at most 0.10 per cell. Robust parallel, incremental sequential and oracle achieve at least 0.95 exact and held-out accuracy in every cell and seed with spurious rate 0 and monotonic energy 1. Robust parallel uses one round, D active updates, absolute per-seed query K slope at most 0.05, and at most 0.12 of classical Hopfield query operations. Its fit operations remain positive and grow with K; the brittle exact-correlation ablation is not required to succeed.
promotion_criteria: A screen may raise confidence but HYP-0007 can become promising only if robust parallel passes every seed and cell, seed CV is at most 0.10, it lies on the accuracy-gated global Pareto frontier including the incremental and oracle controls, and the result remains distinct from Hopfield, sparse parity decoding and known iterative energy models SRC-0025 through SRC-0029.
research_question: Can a learned local energy model recover noisy unequal latent relations and clean unseen compositions in one parallel relaxation round across seeds while retaining a distinct matched-cost signature against Hopfield retrieval and an incremental sequential schedule?
title: Adversarial multi-seed robust relational energy screen
